'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Petr Jacobson DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Petr Jacobson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title Check these Double D's! / Catch Those Double D's. Inventory Petr Jackson.

* '''Player:''' [[Petr Jacobson]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
